summary: Iteration 11 — verified Architect's Critical Sync Debug end-to-end. Both new backend endpoints + all 3 frontend UI surfaces (Sync drift badge, Failed-badge dialog, Copy Diagnostic) are functioning correctly. 9/9 pytest passed, 12/12 UI checks passed.
backend_tested: GET /api/learnforge/reconcile → 200; learnforge_probe.url='https://learnforge-core.vercel.app/api/courses', reachable=false, status_code=404; totals contains syllabus_generated/published/failed/pending ints; drift.count > 0 (4); drift.failed_signals[0] has id/title/status_code=404/hint mentioning 'route'+'deployed'/retry_count/next_retry_at

GET /api/signals/{id}/publish-history?limit=5 → 200; signal object contains all 9 required diag fields (publish_status, last_publish_status_code=404, last_publish_error, last_publish_hint, last_publish_response_preview, last_publish_webhook_url, last_publish_at, publish_retry_count, publish_next_retry_at); history is a list with status_code/error/hint/at per entry; unknown signal returns 404
frontend_tested: Dashboard loads; [data-testid='sync-drift-badge'] visible with text='4' and title='4 courses out of sync · LearnForge HTTP 404'
Click SYNC button → sonner toast 'LearnForge HTTP 404' appears
Signal Tracker row for fixture signal exposes [data-testid='publish-error-btn-e3171073-...] with label 'FAIL 404'

Click FAIL 404 → [data-testid='publish-error-dialog'] opens, contains: 'HTTP 404' banner ('404 · Route not deployed'), Webhook/HTTP/Retries(5/5)/Next retry meta grid, Diagnostic block mentioning '/api/courses route is not deployed', response body '{"detail":"Not Found"}', Last 10 Attempts list each row showing HTTP 404, footer with COPY DIAGNOSTIC + RETRY PUBLISH buttons
COPY DIAGNOSTIC button present and clickable (clipboard write not asserted in headless)
critical_code_review_comments: reconcile_with_learnforge correctly probes GET on the same webhook URL — note remote /api/courses likely only implements POST, so a 404/405 on GET is expected even after deployment. Today it's a true 404 (route absent). Once deployed, the probe may show 405 (method-not-allowed); consider treating 405 as 'reachable=true' since it proves the route exists. Minor — current behavior is acceptable as a strict liveness probe.

publisher._persist correctly caps retry_count at 5 and sets publish_next_retry_at=None at the cap; fixture signal is at 5/5 (terminal). Sync drift will continue to surface it indefinitely until publish succeeds — desired behavior.
PublishErrorDialog re-fetches history after a failed retry and updates state — good. classifyFailure covers 404/401/403/422/5xx/Connect/Timeout — robust.
DashboardHeader Sync button gracefully falls back from onSync to onRefresh when onSync absent — backwards compatible.
